description: RALEIGH – Today, Roy Cooper continued his “Make Stuff Cost Less” tour, holding an event in Greensboro to discuss how he will work in the U.S. Senate to make life more affordable for North Carolina families. “I have a plan to make stuff cost less, I’m running to put the middle class back within reach […]
